subject.title: Add native PowerShell smoke coverage for contributor commands

question: Should the native PowerShell smoke lane include both `pnpm check:docs` and `pnpm build:strict-smoke` now, or start with a smaller proven command set?
rationale: The requested coverage fits the test-infrastructure roadmap, but the active candidate changes recurring Windows runner scope and one selected command fails in live CI.

options.title: Prove full command set
options.body: Keep both requested commands in scope, but land only after the Windows `pwsh` lane passes with redacted proof.

options.title: Start narrower
options.body: Land native PowerShell coverage for only already-passing contributor commands and track `build:strict-smoke` separately.

options.title: Defer CI scope
options.body: Keep this issue open without a recurring Windows smoke lane until runner budget and command ownership are settled.

recommendation.title: Prove full command set
recommendation.body: Keep both requested commands in scope, but land only after the Windows `pwsh` lane passes with redacted proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent overlap across the current Windows CI matrix and adjacent PowerShell-safe docs tooling.
